item.title: Five AI mindsets from a nine-minute pitch, and the three that survive Monday
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line Three of the five can start on Monday, the constraint, the role definition and the learning loop. The other two are a warning and a method that stops halfway and turns into a workbook pitch. 1. Five lines on a whiteboard# 8 minutes 57 seconds, one take, one man standing at a whiteboard.
